description: Look up one order. Use it after purchase to confirm delivery and read the activation code, whenever a purchase returned status processing, and to check data usage. Read-only. Example: {order_id: "ord_..."}. Returns the current order state, eSIM delivery payload, activation and data usage from the supplier, receipts, and the latest disputes (disputes_total counts all). Any agent of the order's principal may call it (and regenerate_activation and request_refund) for the order; other principals get ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

order_id.description: Order id from purchase (order.order_id) or from an earlier order_status call

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: order_status
title: Order status
